name: Icon Spin
description: Icon spin for every gamemode, floor-only spin option, wave stretch/squeeze effect, per-gamemode toggles.

enable-spin.name: Enable Spin
enable-spin.description: Turn the icon spin on or off.

spin-speed.name: Spin Speed
spin-speed.description: Rotation speed in degrees per second. Negative values spin the other way.

spin-floor-only.name: Spin only on floor (like old tps physics)
spin-floor-only.description: Spins only while standing on the floor. On blocks and in the air the game rotates normally.

floor-height.name: Floor Height (advanced)
floor-height.description: Height of the cube's center when standing on the floor. Raise it if the cube does not spin on the floor, lower it if it spins on low blocks.

wave-effect.name: Enable Wave Effect
wave-effect.description: Changes the wave's vertical movement to imitate the old high-TPS bug.

wave-y-scale.name: Wave Vertical Scale
wave-y-scale.description: Below 1 = stretched, flat wave. Above 1 = squeezed, steep wave (looks mini). 1 = normal.

wave-practice-only.name: Only in practice mode
wave-practice-only.description: The effect changes real movement, so keep it to practice mode.
